items.title: Fix proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts snapshot_missing false-negative (RED then GREEN)
items.context: writeCanonicalAcceptanceRegistration's synthetic pureRoot never stubs packages/main/src/core/acceptance-rollout.ts and scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs, which PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY's artifact:acceptance-rollout-report.json entry now pulls into the required snapshot closure alongside handlers/proofstory.ts (acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts buildBoundedSourceGraph, line ~1092). Write a RED script under packages/main/tests/red/ proving the fixture fails on current main, then fix the fixture to stub both files, confirm GREEN.

happy.desc: RED script red-B-74b9-chk001-acceptance-basis.mjs fails on the pre-fix tree with the snapshot_missing/partial signature

edge.desc: Deliberately reverting the stub-content fix reproduces the original snapshot_missing failure, proving the fixture still discriminates a real regression

items.title: Fix field-regression-cli-smoke.ts missing --readManifest + stale assertion pattern (RED then GREEN)
items.context: assertReviewRunStartCliSurface calls review_pass_set without the now-required --readManifest argument (command-catalog.ts), so the real error is an argument-validation failure, not the /already stale|stale/i pattern the fixture own assertion expects. Write a RED script proving the current mismatch, then fix the fixture to pass a valid readManifest matching the shape other passing tests use so it actually exercises the staleness scenario, confirm GREEN.

happy.desc: RED script red-B-74b9-chk002-readmanifest.mjs fails on the pre-fix tree with the readManifest argument-validation mismatch signature

edge.desc: The fixed fixture actual assertion genuinely matches an already-stale review_pass_set response, not merely a non-crashing one -- confirmed by inspecting the real CLI output the test asserts against

items.title: Fix worktree-authority-smoke.ts done_recover post-merge version-bump ENOENT (RED then GREEN)
items.context: assertDoneRecoverRunsPostMergeBuildForRuntimeChanges's synthetic mkdtemp root has no package.json, but done_recover now also runs bumpVersionOnDoneMerge (core/version-bump.ts) which requires root/package.json and the other version sync points to exist, throwing ENOENT before the stubbed build runner is ever reached. Write a RED script proving the current ENOENT, then fix the fixture's root scaffold to include the version sync-point files done_recover's post-merge path now needs, confirm GREEN.

items.title: Decide and record whether the three fixed fixtures should be registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands
items.context: All three fixtures currently run only via the broader root npm test, not lattice validate. After fixing them, decide per-fixture whether they should be added to validate.commands so lattice validate (and REVIEW rounds relying on it) catches this class of regression going forward, and record the reasoning in background.md or plan.md.
